column1: # G'lam OS Partition Table for ESP32-S3 (16MB Flash)
# Flash stores ONLY the OS kernel (ota_0/ota_1 for OS self-OTA) & internal system resources.
# User Apps (.elf / .gla / compat .spk) live on the external TF card (/sdcard/apps/).
# Note: 'storage' (7M @ 0x820000) carries staged boot animation assets flashed with OS;
# on first boot the kernel migrates it to /sdcard/system/boot_anim.gmv and erases 'storage'.
